# App Shell

MobileAppShell (bottom navigation) and DesktopAppShell (sidebar + keyboard commands) compose global navigation, content, and host overlays without owning business routing.

## Composition

Compose public components and contracts; see [App Shell](/en/components/mobile-app-shell).

## States

Cover loading, empty, error, offline, permission, and recovery. Focus enters the new task heading after pane transitions.

## Responsive

Wide screens preserve context; compact widths use a drawer, sheet, overlay, or route.
